recommendations.method_signature: public void updateConversationAdminDeleted(Long id, Boolean adminDeleted)
recommendations.rationale: The method updateConversationAdminDeleted primarily interacts with the data layer and performs an update operation on the database. It would be more appropriate to move this method to the KeFuConversationMapper class.

The method validateKefuConversationExists is responsible for checking the existence of a conversation in the database. This is a data access operation and should be moved to the KeFuConversationMapper class.
The method selectByUserId is a data access method that retrieves a conversation by user ID. It should be moved to the KeFuConversationMapper class as it directly interacts with the database.
